parameters.content:
## OFFENSE: inbound firehose
Anonymous web visitors hit the secured webhook.

## DEFENSE: PLG churn
A 15-minute poller turns `product_usage_log` rows into the same payload shape. Both lanes meet at the Parser.

## CACHE-FIRST ROUTING
Parser (validate + normalize) -> one batched Supabase cache lookup -> new leads get a pending row (blocks duplicate Clay spend) then Clay; returning leads go straight to HubSpot.
## ASYNC ENRICHMENT, GATED AI, CRM SYNC, TELEMETRY

## ERROR LOGGING
Set this workflow as its own Error Workflow in Workflow Settings. Failing nodes route their error output to "Format Node Error" -> system_error_log.
